narrative.overview:
Goodbye is a WhatsApp group, played straight. The page is the chat's night background with its doodle wallpaper; messages are bubbles with tails; notices are the small yellow system pills; the navigation is the bottom bar of a phone app. The parody works through fidelity: a visitor who arrives from a WhatsApp link should feel they never left the app, and then notice the joke.

The system breaks out of WhatsApp only at the big moments. Karantina, a tall condensed poster face, carries the headlines, the countdown's flip digits and the finale; kraft-paper gold marks what the visitor picked and the finale's paper. Everything between those moments stays quiet, dense and familiar, a single chat column no wider than a phone.

It is dark only and Hebrew first. Every edge is logical, so the whole layout mirrors for RTL, and bubble tails flip with it.
keyCharacteristics: WhatsApp dark mode, re-created on purpose: green brand, slate greys, doodle wallpaper.
One chat column, `640px` at most, on every screen.
Tonal depth: page, panel, bubble, each a step lighter.
Karantina for the moments, Rubik for everything else.
Kraft gold is the wink: picks, progress and the finale.

rules.name: The Status Means Something Rule
rules.body: Positive, warning, critical and info colours appear only where they mean that status. A red used for decoration makes the real "exit" stop registering.

rules.name: The Ramp-Only Rule
rules.body: No hex outside `tokens.scss`; `npm run guard` fails the build on one. Every surface and semantic colour is built from the ramps.

rules.name: The Same Colours for Every Story Rule
rules.body: A room's reason for leaving changes its words, never its colours (`docs/DECISIONS.md #14`).

rules.name: The Poster Only Rule
rules.body: Karantina appears only at display size, for a moment worth announcing. Never for body, labels or buttons.

rules.name: The Lighter Means Closer Rule
rules.body: Raise a surface by moving it one neutral step lighter, not by adding a bigger shadow.

dos: **Do** reach for WhatsApp's own pattern first (bubble, system pill, tab bar, sheet).
**Do** use logical properties everywhere, so RTL and LTR both hold.
**Do** keep Karantina for moments: headlines, the countdown, the finale.
**Do** mark the visitor's picks with kraft gold.
**Do** put WhatsApp Green behind dark text (`chat-night`), never white.
**Do** give every control the yellow focus ring, or a shape-fitted variant of it.
donts: **Don't** add a light theme; the app is dark only (`docs/DECISIONS.md #4`).
**Don't** widen the column past `640px` or add an app shell.
**Don't** recolour a room by its reason for leaving.
**Don't** draw icons by hand or import a second icon set; use `lucide-react` through `shared/components/Icon`.
